_overrideNotes._why: npm ignores unknown top-level keys and package.json admits no comments. Every entry in `overrides` must name the advisory it escapes and the range it must exceed, because the VERSION is never what moves — the advisory does. Both pre-existing overrides here were correct on the day they were written and had silently stopped being floors by 2026-08-23, in two opposite ways.
_overrideNotes.postcss: GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp, GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849. Vulnerable range <=8.5.22; must exceed 8.5.22. Pinned to 8.5.23, the OLDEST version that exits the range — published 2026-07-24, 29 days soaked, against 8.5.26's 16. `npm audit fix` picks the newest; the oldest that exits clears the same advisories with more soak behind it.
_overrideNotes.protobufjs: GHSA-j3f2-48v5-ccww. Vulnerable range >=7.5.0 <=7.6.4 (upper bound INCLUSIVE); must exceed 7.6.4. Pinned 7.6.5, the only version that exits. Was `^7.6.3` from v0.18.3 (731dad7), which cleared a then-critical advisory by resolving 7.6.4 — correct when written. A later advisory widened to include 7.6.4 and the floor was inside the range it existed to escape, while still looking like the thing that had handled it.
_overrideNotes.esbuild: GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr. Vulnerable range >=0.27.3 <0.28.1; must reach 0.28.1. Pinned 0.28.1, the OLDEST version that exits — and the only fix in this whole campaign that is ALSO soaked (published 2026-06-11, 72 days). 0.28.2 is 14 days old and clears the same advisory; taking the oldest exit is what makes this one policy-compliant rather than an exception. Needs vite >= 7.3.6, which widened its declared range to `^0.27.0 || ^0.28.0` — that declaration is the parent's own certification that 0.28.x works, and is why this is not an out-of-scope major under R1. A pin is required because esbuild is transitive and npm offers no other mechanism for one.
_overrideNotes.@grpc/grpc-js: No advisory currently flags any 1.9.x. Added at v0.18.3 (731dad7) as a real floor clearing a then-high advisory. Measured inert 2026-08-23: @firebase/firestore itself declares ~1.9.0, 1.9.16 is the top of that line, and a fresh resolution gives 1.9.16 with the override present AND absent. Kept rather than deleted — deletion has measured-zero benefit and unmeasured risk — but it is NOT doing work today.
